mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are looking at a clear and comfortable 67 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, and with the moon in its first quarter phase, it is a lovely week to be outside.

The city council recently approved a new fee structure for sewer and stormwater utilities. These services are self-supporting, meaning rates cover the necessary costs for maintenance and equipment to prevent service failures like sewer backups or flooding.

There is plenty to do over the next few days. Today features the Epic Systems UGM, yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow brings live music to Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding local enforcement, a notable incident occurred on Friday when police responded to a report of a reckless driver. The 29-year-old was ultimately arrested for a second O W I and cited for driving with a revoked license.
Make sure to satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor, Chocolate Heath Crunch. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to head over for a scoop.
